title: Concept: Server-side fetch through Source.fromURL in scala — review required
description: In scala, Source.fromURL performs an outbound request with the JVM network stack. The call is often used to read a remote configuration or template and therefore receives a value that originates from a request. There is no egress policy in the API, so loopback and metadata addresses are reachable by default.
applicability: scala services that fetch remote documents or templates.
risk: Access to internal services and metadata endpoints; MEDIUM severity.
